responsibility: This OS integration header supplies the MIPS-specific GCC configuration for VxWorks targets. It defines assembler and linker specs, forwards library/startfile/endfile handling to the generic VxWorks support layer, installs VxWorks-oriented preprocessor builtins describing CPU width, endianness, and soft-float mode, disables MIPS small-data usage, suppresses normal _mcount profiling, and adds RTP/PIC assembler handling, making it the main MIPS/VxWorks target policy header.
